Mozilla PDF.js 5.6.205 (legacy browser distribution)
Source: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
License: Apache-2.0; see LICENSE and licenses in standard_fonts/ and wasm/.

Used only when opening the on-demand document preview. Original PDFs are not
modified. One document and one canvas are active at a time. Closing the detail
dialog releases the worker/document. Third-party scripts are served locally.

Bundled files: legacy/build/pdf.min.mjs, legacy/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs,
standard_fonts/*, wasm/*, and upstream license files.
